verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a community user who reports using TeamViewer to log into Windows and launch Steam on a remote PC. That implies keyboard and mouse input reaches the host, but no documentation describes input forwarding. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of mouse/keyboard forwarding, any evidence of scroll input, evidence that input is injected as native OS events (e.g., shortcuts, special keys, modifier handling), independent hands-on corroboration of input fidelity.

support.subject: As a power user, mouse, keyboard, and scroll input from the viewing device lands on the host as native events

citations.quote: Uses TeamViewer on one gaming PC only to log into Windows and start Steam after Wake-on-LAN over a home VPN
